profile.headline: Software Engineer at TransCore
profile.summary:
• 15+ years of experience as a developer using Microsoft Visual Studio Technologies, VB.net, and C# for web applications including web services, WCF. ASP.NET .NET, .NET Core
• Web development using Angular, AngularJS, HTML5, JavaScript, Bootstrap, CSS,  ServiceStack, KnockOut.js, Durandal, Flex, Nodejs, npm
• REST and SOAP.
• Experience with MVC and MVVM.
• 5 years of experience as a developer using Adobe Flex as front end with PHP and ASP.net as server-side technology. Programming RIA’s - Rich Internet Applications, using Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL as a DBMS.
• Proficiency in RDBMS concepts, and data modeling and extensively worked with relational databases like MSSQL Server and MySQL.
• Have total exposure to the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including analyzing, designing, developing, and testing.
• Experience working in remote development environments.
• 10+ years working in Agile Development environments, using SCRUM.
• Good working knowledge of GIT, DevOps SVN, and Team Foundation Server for code management and version control.
• CI/CD: DevOps, GitHub Actions, Octopus, TeamCity
• Experience with Tableau Reports and Tableau Rest API.
• Strong Experience using and creating Custom Spark and MX components and Events.
• Strong Experience with ActionScript3 and Object Oriented Programming.
• 2 years of experience using Adobe LiveCycle, LCDS, and Model-driven software development with Adobe Flex Technologies. 
• 4 years of experience using, installing, and configuring SQL Server Reporting Services as a reporting technology for web applications.
• 5+ years of experience as a developer with Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0 for desktop applications.
• 1 year experience in the manufacturing industry, at Rapid Manufacturing developing different projects for internal processes.
• Fast learner and enjoy the challenges when having to use a new technology
